meetings.title: Insights squad standup
segments: Hi everyone. Big day tomorrow-ish with the alignment meeting, so let's be fast. Priya, you first today?
Sure. I re-ran the full eval with the new embedding model and the re-ranking.
We're at seventy-nine percent. So up from seventy-eight, but I was hoping for more.
Seventy-nine is still real progress.
Is that the number for the alignment deck?
Yes. I'll put the eval sheet together for the alignment meeting, with the failure examples, so people can see what the errors actually look like.
Perfect. Marcus?
Design crit is this afternoon for dashboard v3.
The big thing is Themes as the default, plus a first pass at merge and split.
And I'm on a new headset, so hopefully no robot voice this time.
No promises.
I finished the exports refactor.
The job queue is now generic, so other features can use it.
That's probably useful for the clustering work too.
Very useful. That's exactly what the nightly re-cluster would run on.
I'm running the online migration tool against a staging copy of the events table.
I'm blocked because the staging snapshot is three weeks old, and the table structure has changed since then.
I'll refresh the staging snapshot tonight.
You'll have it in the morning.
Thanks.
And for me, I've been putting together capacity numbers for tomorrow.
I'll be honest, we can't do SSO and Jira both this quarter.
I'll show the math tomorrow.
Good, I'd rather hear it tomorrow than find out in a month. Thanks everyone.
